about:
Bernman Mold & Engineering Inc. has operated as a family-owned business in Ontario, California since 1994. The company traces its roots to Manuel J. Solorio Sr., who founded a precision mold manufacturing shop in Upland, California. After more than two decades at that location, the operation moved to a 7,000-square-foot facility in Ontario, where Solorio's son, Manuel A. Solorio Jr., now serves as owner.

The shop produces custom steel molds and provides a range of mold-related services including molding, advanced polishing, new tooling, laser welding, CNC machining, and reverse engineering. A team of about ten works with equipment such as Haas and Okuma machining centers, Mitsubishi EDM machines, a Mitutoyo CMM, and a laser welder. The company emphasizes its combined 60-plus years of mold-making experience.

Bernman serves customers in medical, aerospace, military, irrigation, agriculture, cosmetic, electronics and technology, and automotive sectors. The company states it can refurbish, repair, design, and inject molds for these industries.

The business highlights its "100% Made in America" production and a problem-solving approach that aims to turn product ideas into reality. Its family ownership and deep mold-making heritage are presented as key differentiators.
